column1: # ADDENDUM to docs/audit_source_tarball_hash_map_20260804.tsv.
# Amendment 4 (signed 2026-08-04) cites a "full 54-row mapping". That mapping
# was computed at 83d2b6c and is correct and unchanged: all 54 rows were
# reproduced byte-for-byte when the rewrite was actually applied on 2026-08-06,
# including the bb45528 -> ed92ae8 remap the amendment turns on.
# It is nevertheless SHORT BY FIVE COMMITS, because five commits were made
# after the map was computed and each carries the tarball in its tree, so each
# is rewritten too. This file records those five. The signed file is NOT edited.
# THREE OF THE FIVE ARE AMENDMENT 4'S OWN COMMITS. The commit that signed and
# appended Amendment 4, 02ea10b, becomes 5339a48. An amendment that exists to
# remap a signature's provenance pointer therefore moves its own. This is the
# same defect one level up, and it is recorded rather than quietly absorbed --
# whether it needs its own dated amendment is the decision owner's call, not
# this file's.
# Applied 2026-08-06 with the SAME tool the signed map was computed with,
# git filter-branch --index-filter, on a disposable clone containing only
# `main`. Using a different tool was rejected: commit hashes are a function of
# the tool's exact output, and a tool substitution that shifted any of the 54
# would have falsified a signed document.
# Verified on application: 256 commits before and after, none pruned; author,
# email, author date, committer, committer date and subject byte-identical for
# every commit; the tarball the only path differing in any tree; the blob
# absent from the object database and unreachable from every ref; and
# 987377a (tag v1.0.0) unchanged and still an ancestor of the sanitized tip,
# so publication is a fast-forward and no force push is required.
# The tag pre-source-tarball-removal-20260802 was DELETED from the publication
# clone rather than remapped: it marks the state that still contained the
# tarball, so a remapped version of it would point at a tree without it and
# assert something false. That state is preserved outside the repository, in
# the sealed pre-rewrite backup bundle of 2026-08-06.
